comments.snippet:
Thanks for the auto-report — the stack trace pinned this precisely.

**Root cause:** middle-clicking a connection tab hit a redundant close path. The bundled docking library (DockPanelSuite) closes a tab *synchronously* on middle-click, right inside the mouse-down message.
